---
name: Planning proposal
about: Propose a bounded research or design decision; implementation is not approved
title: ''
---

## Decision or problem

What needs to be decided, and for which user?

## Evidence and alternatives

Link primary sources with review dates. Distinguish facts, assumptions, hypotheses, and proposed behavior. Include evidence that could disprove the recommendation.

## Proposed outcome

Describe the planning artifact or decision, not unapproved implementation work.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Outcome is reviewable and scoped.
- [ ] Dependencies and unresolved questions are identified.
- [ ] No live data, secrets, or private organizational assets are included.

## Dependencies and required approvals

State whether this requires ownership, publication, licensing, spending, external calls, outreach, or implementation approval. An issue does not grant those approvals.

## Suggested priority and labels

Choose proposed labels from docs/BACKLOG.md. They may not exist in GitHub yet.
